mechanism.claim: During the completed Asian session, simultaneous AUD weakness and JPY strength identify a carry unwind while simultaneous AUD strength and JPY weakness identify carry relief. In a high-variation BTC regime, trade BTC with risk relief and against risk unwind for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: short when USDAUD return is positive and USDJPY return is negative; long for the exact symmetric concordance
mechanism.why_distinct: SHRR used a standardized three-leg SEK/CHF/JPY European-session median with a magnitude tail; UJCVR used USDJPY alone; dollar-factor candidates measured common USD direction. ACUCR uses raw two-leg Asia-session carry concordance, no magnitude threshold, no reused event set, and no promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed pre-decision 24-hour BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one weekday 08:05 UTC external carry-concordance clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: bars_polygon 1m USDAUD and USDJPY rows with 00:00<=UTC time<08:00 on one weekday
features.session_valid: each pair has at least 450 distinct minutes, first<=00:05, last>=07:55, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.returns: log(session close/session open) independently for USDAUD and USDJPY
features.risk_pressure: USDAUD return for AUD weakness and negative USDJPY return for JPY strength
features.concordance: both risk-pressure components have the same strict nonzero sign; opposite signs or zero are ineligible
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared completed-hour BTC returns over 24 hours ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 08:00 UTC after both FX sessions and BTC variation complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no pair set, concordance, volatility, side, session, clock, hold, subset, or control repair
